channel.title: Best New Albums
channel.description: The most exciting and important new albums being released today.

item.title: Ultimate Love Forever
item.description: Earnest and disaffected, ironic and confrontational, the Brooklyn songwriter’s Sub Pop debut channels trans rage into scrappy DIY punk with no patience left.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Jocelyn

item.title: Punching the Clown
item.description: Kurt Wagner reinvents his band yet again, this time slimming down to a bare-bones acoustic setup and stripping away the studio artifice. But his storytelling remains as expansive as ever.
item.dc:creator: Sam Sodomsky
